title: IFCS1310-TAGBANK: saturated boosted implicit fibers with linear classical bits and lazy counted quantum records

claims.statement: For every N>=2,s in Z/NZ,n=ceil(log2N), the SAME physical IFCS1310-TAGBANK interpreter of proof.md executing COMPLETE IFCS1310S60 P in virtual-phase.md and virtual-decode.md recovers the WHOLE secret with unconditional probability at least1-2^-8 from independent ideal copies. All guarantees hold jointly on EVERY branch, including wrong labels, failed/rejected/discarded inputs, source/fallback aborts, initialization and cleanup. Fully charged time is O(2^((3403/2000)*sqrt n)), exact growth index1/2. Direct known-index basis-bit operations and lazy per-cell epoch tags cost polynomial overhead per source logical bit/gate/object operation. Every epoch word has (n+2)^20 COUNTED basis bits and is processed bit-serially with O(n) ordinary staging. Exact full renumbering repairs overflow with NO new failure/source event at every length; eventually no overflow occurs because log total generations is O(sqrt n). Complete reference branchwise work is O(n^(9/2)*2^(tau0*sqrt n)), tau0=244792007/143976000<3403/2000. Strict rational time slack absorbs all interpreter polynomials. One-time complete bank initialization/cleanup is smaller since mu0=5999/10000<tau0. Actual finite-length renumbering costs change only an outside constant. Original source/quantum instruments, caps, saturated windows and decoders are unchanged. No QRAM or assumed cheap full clear is used.

The (n+2)^20-bit epoch VALUES are NEVER ordinary classical operands: tags, headers/global generation/backup words, return frames, numeric scratch, owner directory and all source records are fully banked. All long loops stream their fields. No physical classical recursion stack, large directory or growing measurement transcript exists.

Every logical bit has one value and e=(n+2)^20 tag bits; complete D=B*(e+1)+(A+8)*e+A+H+2^20*n^4 includes RAW headers/global epoch/backup, bindings, coherent pool H=2^32*n^2 and all unused spans. Exact gap3/5-mu0=1/10000 absorbs every polynomial into the pure declared quantum envelope. This is maximum-address storage independent of lifetime, not occupancy. Renumbering uses only its counted backup and fixed bank, with source coherent registers preserved.

Full reference proves Qcap=O(n^2*2^(H0*sqrt n)),H0=187165613/143976000<13/10. Its strict rational gap absorbs polynomial n^2. Guaranteed malformed fraction is epsilon(n)=0 under the exact independent-ideal-copy model. The decoded correlated-CQ invariant pi composed with each physical logical-step instrument equals P composed with pi, including irreversible forgetting, allocation/free, exact overflow renumbering and original quantum/source operations. structured.error_model: Malformed fraction among acquired copies. The proved guarantee requires every copy to be an independent ideal coset state; no behavior is promised for malformed copies.
